counterfactual_missing_items: No epistaxis or nasopharyngeal vascular mass to support Juvenile Nasopharyngeal Angiofibroma
No vasculitis, necrosis, or ANCA-associated features to support Granulomatosis with Polyangiitis
No ground-glass or fibrous-osseous matrix to support Fibrous Dysplasia
decisive_items: Tissue analysis showed spindle cell process in a patternless arrangement with significant multinucleated giant cells
response.rationale: R2 is directly supported by the diagnostic biopsy showing spindle cells with multinucleated giant cells, rare mitoses, and no atypia, matching giant cell tumor. R3 shares sinonasal mass, proptosis, and erosion but lacks the defining biopsy and is unlikely in a teenage girl without epistaxis. R4 and R1 have only nonspecific or absent raw support.

rejected.why: Only nonspecific sinus pressure and maxillary sinus mass; no vasculitis, necrosis, ANCA, or giant-cell biopsy support.
No raw support spans; bony remodeling is nonspecific and contradicted by the spindle/giant-cell biopsy.
Shares sinonasal mass and erosion but lacks biopsy support; demographic and clinical features do not fit juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma.
